messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=streaming-proxy-eu severity=sev2 at 2026-03-15T09:20:34Z - p99 latency breach / streaming stalls detected
sam (oncall): I'm paged, coming in. seeing alerts on dashboards; p95 ~ 420ms -> p99 ~ 3.2s on /v1/stream endpoint (EU).
tara (sre): +1. I'm pulling traces now. CPU/GPU look ok, tails spike seems correlated with proxy write latency.
chen (runtime): noticed increased client TCP RTOs from a subset of customers in eu-west-1, likely slow consumers/backpressure.
zoe (support): customer-ops flagged two affected customers on dedicated lanes; both report intermittent truncation then reconnects. Ticket numbers: #CUST-4721, #CUST-4729.
sam (oncall): quick triage: is this a runtime stall (kv cache) or proxy/backpressure? Which service currently top of flame graph?
tara (sre): proxy write stalls top. stack: streaming-proxy -> connection-writer-loop stalls(msg_queue_len grows) -> downstream client ACK slowdown.
chen (runtime): reproduction notes: under synthetic slow-client test (limit recv window 1KB/s) we see proxy buffers fill, keepalive/liveness with upstream times out at ~30s leading to chunk flush delay.
sam (oncall): OK mitigation goals: 1) reduce customer impact quickly 2) stop p99 spikes 3) restore streaming flow. suggestions?
tara (sre): immediate mitigations: - enable aggressive keepalive/psuedo-ack timeouts on proxy (reduce idle timeout) - enable backpressure-based connection drop for stuck streams > 12s - flow-control: cap per-connection buffer to 64KB
chen (runtime): can push a config toggle to proxy fleet for eu region in <8m. I'll stage to 10% first.
sam (oncall): do it. 10% canary -> monitor p99. If good, roll to 100% in 5-10m.
devproxy-bot: Deploy started: cfg toggle streaming.buffer_cap=64KB; keepalive_timeout=12s to streaming-proxy-eu canary (10%) by chen. CI jobs passed.
tara (sre): watching metrics: canary shows immediate drop on queue_length for affected hosts. p99 down from 3.2s -> 480ms on canary hosts.
zoe (support): telling impacted customers we're doing an emergency config change; advising retry/backoff on client SDKs.
sam (oncall): roll to 100%. Chen, proceed. Note: add circuit-break metric and alert if error rate rises > 1% during rollout.
devproxy-bot: Deploy started: cfg toggle rolled to 100% in eu region.
tara (sre): metrics: global p99 across eu endpoints dropping to ~520ms; error rate unchanged. client retransmits decreased.
chen (runtime): follow-up patch: bump streaming socket opts to set TCP_QUICKACK (where available) and lower internal writer flush interval to 10ms for streaming path; will schedule for tomorrow (non-urgent) after postmortem.
sam (oncall): customer impact summary so far?
zoe (support): two customers reported degraded UX (reconnects / partial payloads) for ~25-30 minutes starting at 09:18Z. Both have retries in place; no data loss confirmed. No other major customers flagged.
tara (sre): incident classification: sev2 (SLO breach p99 for ~20m across EU region). Root cause: slow consumer/client backpressure amplifying proxy write buffering + conservative keepalive causing long tail blocking.
sam (oncall): timeline note: 09:18Z — first spike; 09:20Z — pager; 09:28Z — canary applied; 09:36Z — full rollout; 09:45Z — p99 stable.
chen (runtime): immediate mitigations completed. Next actions: 1) create runbook section for streaming slow-client detection & mitigations 2) add e2e test for slow-consumer behavior 3) monitor for recurrence for 72h
tara (sre): logging follow-up: add more granular metric streaming.proxy.conn_buffer_bytes and per-route slow_consumer_count. I'll open the infra PR.
sam (oncall): will open incident ticket and link customers + timeline. Add postmortem owners: tara (lead), chen (runtime), zoe (customer comms).
zoe (support): drafting customer message: summary of incident, mitigation, recommended client SDK backoff settings, and ETA for permanent fixes.
tara (sre): quick note: we saw one proxy instance with stale epoll fd backlog causing slower writer loop — small chance it's a code path bug. we're instrumenting and will roll a patch if reproducer found.
chen (runtime): also planning to expose per-connection diagnostics in internal console to speed triage next time.
sam (oncall): closing immediate paging. If p99 regresses, page SRE immediately. Otherwise we'll run postmortem and follow the action list. Thanks all. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and transitioned to "mitigated" at 2026-03-15T09:47:12Z by sam (oncall).
zoe (support): postmortem draft will be ready EOD; customer messages queued for 10:30Z UTC.
tara (sre): action items created: INFRA-981 backing per-route metrics, RUNTIME-142 add slow-client test, DOCS-344 runbook updates.
chen (runtime): note for handoff: monitor eu p99 closely for next 12h for any slow consumer regressions.
sam (oncall): last check 09:57Z: p99 stable at 480-560ms in EU. I'll handoff to morning oncall for watch. Handoff notes: mitigation toggles, links to dashboards, customer tickets.
zoe (support): acknowledged handoff and will update customers once postmortem links are live.
(tara, sam, chen reacted :eyes: and :thumbsup:)
